name: Design System Foundations
description: Produces a foundational design system specification with spacing scale, type scale, color token structure, border radius, and shadow variables as a tool-agnostic token system. Use when the user asks to create a design system, define design tokens, establish a visual language, or set up consistent spacing and typography rules. Do NOT use for full brand identity (use brand-identity-brief), color palette creation (use color-palette-design), or typography pairing decisions (use typography-system).
